unresolved_added: The official task text is unavailable; requirements are reconstructed only from the paper.
The paper is a Finalist, so no writing or modeling choice may be claimed to have caused an Outstanding award.
AQI is used as the sole Earth-health proxy although it communicates local human-health risk and omits most environmental and biological systems.
The global weighted mean does not specify how node weights are chosen, normalized, or updated.
The claim that neural networks extract reliable features from a relatively small sample is unsupported and conflicts with small-sample estimation risk.
The claim that shared inputs make multiple-output networks less accurate is asserted without an architecture or comparison.
BP and PSO have no activation functions, loss, architecture, train-validation split, optimizer parameters, stopping rule, or fitted weights.
PSO is said to rarely get stuck in a local optimum, but no baseline or repeated-seed evidence is provided.
The methodology advertises indefinitely long forecasts from little data, while verification later says accumulated error makes long forecasts meaningless.
The paper declines a generic tipping criterion but later labels forecast bounces as tipping points without a predeclared rule.
The basic factors are selected by data availability and omit policy, natural emissions, transport, consumption, and other acknowledged drivers.
The basic feedback function is dimensionally unexplained and grows exponentially with distance, contrary to the stated relationship-tightness role.
Country nodes use capital coordinates and ignore topography, within-country heterogeneity, borders, and atmospheric transport paths.
The advanced Gaussian model is described but explicitly never verified or integrated with the basic country-node model.
The plume expression fixes a 500-unit vertical offset and omits source height definition, ground reflection, stability class, deposition, boundaries, and units.
Country emission density is converted to AQI using one year's paired ranges without demonstrating pollutant compatibility or correlation strength.
The AQI breakpoint interpolation is repurposed for aggregate national emissions despite incompatible pollutant, temporal, and spatial units.
Nations with too little data are deleted without an inventory, missingness rule, or selection-bias analysis.
Figure 4 is captioned stepwise forecast while the prose describes an autonomous holdout forecast after 30 training years.
Autonomous forecasts explicitly exclude policy and other exterior influences, yet later case studies attribute forecast-actual divergence to policy reforms.
Accumulated recursive error is admitted, but no valid horizon, calibration curve, stability diagnostic, or uncertainty band is reported.
Local verification is declared equivalent to global verification without testing aggregation, network cascades, or global tipping behavior.
Fit is judged satisfactory by eye; no loss, baseline, holdout metric, confidence interval, or leakage check is supplied.
The criticality function is improvised with arbitrary scales and exponents, grows with distance, and is not validated against impact outcomes.
Figure 5 shows only selected important nations and provides no selection rule, numeric labels, comparator, or error assessment.
Removing China and retraining changes both topology and fitted parameters; seeds, splits, and metrics are not controlled, so Figure 6 does not isolate relationship sensitivity.
Figure 7 has no quantitative legend, color scale, source mapping, uncertainty, or reproducible country values.
Japan's forecast divergence is labeled an irreversible 1993 tipping point without an observed transition, threshold, or reversibility test.
India's no-reform counterfactual is inferred from a policy-free autonomous path without an intervention variable or causal design.
Hungary's policy effect and optimal-decision claim likewise rely on historical coincidence and forecast-actual divergence.
Country cases switch between fit verification, warning, counterfactual, and causal interpretation without separate metrics or validation protocols.
The conclusion claims complete functionality and decision support beyond the qualitative and confounded evidence shown.
The authors admit only 30 training samples, omitted factors, high sensitivity, link-function difficulty, and long training, but supply no repair experiment.
No executable code, frozen data, fitted weights, source-country list, software versions, random seeds, or machine-readable forecasts are supplied.
